tradeoffs.title: Templates vs custom build
tradeoffs.question: How much custom software do we build?

optionA.label: Templates + ChatGPT Teams
optionA.summary: Start with prompts, shared docs, and light automation. Fastest path.

optionB.label: Custom platform
optionB.summary: Build integrated tools from scratch. Higher cost and maintenance.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Phase 1 should be templates + ChatGPT Teams. Build custom only where B9 is unique.

tradeoffs.title: Assist vs automate
tradeoffs.question: Should AI send messages to talent and clients directly?

optionA.label: Assist (human sends)
optionA.summary: AI drafts; a person reviews and sends. Safer for brand and compliance.

optionB.label: Automate (AI sends)
optionB.summary: AI sends routine messages. Faster but higher trust and compliance risk.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Default to assist until Brenda confirms talent-side AI is acceptable.

tradeoffs.title: Buy vs build vs configure
tradeoffs.question: How do we add new capabilities?

optionA.label: Configure existing tools
optionA.summary: ChatGPT Teams, StaffConnect exports, QuickBooks — extend what you have.

optionB.label: Buy dedicated SaaS
optionB.summary: RFP tools, staffing platforms — pay for proven workflows.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Configure first, buy when volume justifies it, build orchestration on Render only when needed.

tradeoffs.title: Exports vs API integrations
tradeoffs.question: How do we connect AI to StaffConnect and accounting?

optionA.label: Manual exports / copy-paste
optionA.summary: Export CSV or copy data into AI workspace. Zero integration cost.

optionB.label: Live API integrations
optionB.summary: Real-time data sync. Higher build cost and vendor dependency.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Exports first. API integrations only after a pilot proves ROI.

tradeoffs.title: One AI vendor vs multi-model
tradeoffs.question: Do we lock into one AI provider?

optionA.label: One workspace vendor
optionA.summary: ChatGPT Teams for the team day-to-day. Simple admin.

optionB.label: Model-agnostic backend
optionB.summary: Swap models as capabilities improve. Slightly more setup.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: ChatGPT Teams for daily work; model-agnostic orchestration layer for guided workflows like this app.

tradeoffs.title: Speed vs compliance depth
tradeoffs.question: How fast do we ship talent-facing AI?

optionA.label: Ship safe wins first
optionA.summary: Email triage, quotes, recaps — 10 use cases with minimal compliance risk.

optionB.label: Move fast on matching/scoring
optionB.summary: Talent ranking, flake detection — higher regulatory exposure.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Ship 10 Phase 1 use cases as-is. Redesign 4 compliance-sensitive ones before talent-facing pilots.

tradeoffs.title: Point wiring vs unified inbox
tradeoffs.question: How do we connect WhatsApp, SMS, and StaffConnect?

optionA.label: One workflow at a time
optionA.summary: Twilio or Zapier for a single pilot (FAQ or no-show). Prove it before buying a platform.

optionB.label: Unified inbox (Whippy/Sense)
optionB.summary: Omnichannel from day one. Higher cost; cleaner ops if volume justifies it.

tradeoffs.recommendationText: Pete's wiring instinct is right — start with one trigger → one channel → human review. Unified inbox after a 90-day pilot proves the channel.
